title: A street market in your city / A street market where you did shopping – IELTS MASTER
topic: Talk about a time when you gave advice to someone
supporting_text:
Latest Makkar cue cards with new solutions

1. My city is known for two things – food and clothes.
2. The variety in both the categories is just staggering.
3. And the reasonable prices just add to the attraction for the buyers who comprise not only of local residents but also consumers from other states.
4. There are several shopping venues which are popular in my city but there is one particular place that epitomizes the things my city is famous for.
5. The place is Grand Avenue market which is the busiest street market in the city.
6. There are several reasons behind huge popularity of this market.
7. One of the biggest advantages of the market is its central location which makes it easily accessible to all the people of the city.


8. But for me the main attraction is the options that it provides me.
9. I am not a brand conscious person but I don’t mind wearing branded clothes either.
10. I am not willing to pay exorbitant price just to put a brand name on my clothes.
11. For me there should be a balance between the appearance of a clothing and the price I pay for it.
12. And that is why I love this place because it gives me that perfect balance.
13. All the major clothing brands have their outlets in this market.
14. Every time I visit these outlets I can easily find some offers running which allow me to make good purchases within my purchasing power.
15. I might not get the best of the lot but I always get decent clothes at reasonable prices.
16. I have already gathered a nice collection of clothes, shoes and some accessories.
17. There is one more reason why I like this place and that is food shops present there.
18. Every time I go there for shopping, I specially reserve extra half an hour for a visit to the food shops.
19. I simply love the place for the options it provides which I don’t normally find at other food joints.


20. I can choose from all the popular cuisines including Indian, Continental, Chinese, Mexican, Mughlai, Italian and many more.
21. I find this place really exciting and whenever I am a bit stressed I visit there with my friends.
